calculate_iou_rotated_bboxes: calculate intersection over union between two sets of rotated bounding boxes in x, y, w, h, angle format
calculate_iof_rotated_bboxes: calculate intersection over foreground between two sets of rotated bounding boxes using mode iof
calculate_aligned_iou_rotated: calculate aligned intersection over union between paired rotated bounding boxes by setting aligned to True
calculate_ccw_rotated_iou: calculate intersection over union of rotated boxes using counter-clockwise angle convention by setting clockwise to False
review_box_iou_rotated: review the box_iou_rotated function that computes IoU/IoF for rotated bounding boxes with clockwise and counter-clockwise support
